origin_and_rationale: Neutral midpoint of the sigmoid output; kept identical across architectures and targets so the controlled comparison did not tune a different cutoff for each model.
verification: The same cutoff is recorded in training and final inference code.
limitation: No class-specific threshold sweep or external calibration was performed.

value: image 512; batch 2; LR 0.001; weight decay 0.0001; maximum 50 epochs; early stopping 10 or 15
origin_and_rationale: A common optimization budget was used to isolate architecture and transfer-initialization effects. LA used patience 15 rather than 10 because its validation criterion combines positive-mask overlap and empty-mask false positives.
verification: Nine final pretrained runs were reconciled against configurations, logs and the same 101 test identifiers.
limitation: These values establish comparability, not global optimality.

value: ROI max(16,500s); liver max(16,200s); LA max(4,8s), s=HW/786432
origin_and_rationale: Remove isolated pixel islands before anatomical measurements while retaining very small candidate LA regions. Scaling preserves the same fractional meaning at other frame sizes.
verification: Applied identically in external inference; the code contains no hole filling.
limitation: No grid search quantified the individual influence of these cleanup floors.

parameter: ROI, black-frame, liver and LA gates
value: ROI/frame >=0.05; >0.80 pixels below intensity 15 rejected; liver >=200s; liver/ROI >=0.15; LA >=50s
origin_and_rationale: Prevent a trivial component, mostly black frame, very small liver prediction or tiny LA artifact from entering the feature rule. The 786432 reference area is exactly 1024x768.
verification: P005 leave-one-gate-out records show ROI/liver gates were not the external bottleneck; LA presence and area were limiting.
limitation: The gates were not optimized on an independent cohort and must be recalibrated for other equipment or image geometry.

origin_and_rationale: Integer result of max(20,P5) over 54 clear train/validation cases with LA and valid texture region. A lower-tail cutoff retains approximately 95 percent of the reference areas while excluding unusually small candidates; the floor 20 was inactive because P5 was 874.7.
verification: threshold_summary.csv reproduces 874; P005 ablation shows seven medium acceptances only when this gate is removed.
limitation: Reference cases are dominated by P001 and no external threshold optimization was performed.

origin_and_rationale: P90 of the same 54 clear train/validation cases. An upper-tail cutoff lets approximately 90 percent of the clear reference distribution pass while rejecting unusually dispersed lumen intensities.
verification: Stored source-resolution measurements reproduce the percentile.
limitation: Dataset-specific image-quality proxy; no causal physiological interpretation or independent calibration.

origin_and_rationale: P90 of the same 54 clear train/validation cases. The upper-tail cutoff retains approximately 90 percent of the reference entropy distribution and rejects unusually diverse gray-level-pair patterns.
verification: Stored GLCM measurements reproduce the percentile.
limitation: Performance contribution could not be isolated in P005 because no anchor case passed the upstream LA gates.

value: 32 gray levels; distance 1; offsets 0, 45, 90 and 135 degrees; symmetric matrices; mean over valid offsets
origin_and_rationale: Thirty-two levels reduce the matrix from 65536 to 1024 cells relative to 256 levels, improving count stability in a small mask. Four unit-distance directions reduce dependence on one image orientation while preserving local texture.
verification: The code records contrast, entropy, homogeneity, energy and valid-pair count; only entropy enters the decision.
limitation: No levels or offset ablation was performed.

origin_and_rationale: An odd centered kernel expands LA by seven pixels per side to include immediate perivascular context and provide enough within-mask pixel pairs for GLCM; intersection with ROI prevents inclusion outside the ultrasound field.
verification: The reproducible region figure and valid-pair counts verify the implemented geometry.
limitation: No kernel-size sweep or physical pixel-spacing calibration was available.

origin_and_rationale: An odd centered kernel expands LA by four pixels per side; subtracting LA isolates a narrower local ring than the texture neighborhood so border contrast is measured immediately outside the lumen.
verification: The region figure distinguishes the border ring from the GLCM region.
limitation: No kernel-size sweep or physical pixel-spacing calibration was available.

origin_and_rationale: P15 of 41 previously base-accepted P001 clear train/validation cases. Because each branch is a minimum-evidence test, P15 was selected to retain about 85 percent of the reference cases per cue while rejecting its weakest tail.
verification: border_rule_threshold_summary.csv records patient, quality, splits, count and quantile.
limitation: Single-patient reference and reuse of the derivation data prevent an independent specificity claim.

value: (bright delta AND bright ratio) OR gradient OR local contrast
origin_and_rationale: The bright branch needs both greater intensity and enough bright pixels. Logical OR across bright, gradient and local-contrast branches permits alternative numerical manifestations of a visible border instead of requiring all three simultaneously.
verification: The branch flags and final OR are stored for every evaluated frame.
limitation: No comparison of AND versus OR was performed on an independent cohort.

value: top 10 percent and lateral 7 percent excluded; max(24,background median+8); close 17x17 x2; open 5x5 x1; component >=8 percent; box width/height >=35 percent and width <=92 percent; margin 8
origin_and_rationale: Suppress annotations and dark margins, join the fan interior, remove small islands and reject implausible geometry; failed geometry falls back to the full frame rather than discarding a sample.
verification: Fan detection succeeded in 840/840 audited development and external sampled images. Final use of crop versus full frame was selected by LOPO evidence per view.
limitation: Constants were not optimized by a crop-parameter grid and may depend on device layout.

origin_and_rationale: Adjacent frames were highly redundant; sampling one in five reduces embedding extraction by 80 percent while retaining chronological coverage within every video. The same reset-per-video rule was used for development and external evaluation.
verification: The redundancy audit found 3998/4000 adjacent pairs below the declared 0.005 normalized-MAD audit cutoff; stride 5 produced 651 development embeddings.
limitation: The 0.005 audit cutoff and stride 5 were not selected by a task-performance sweep.

value: 5 embeddings; mean plus population standard deviation; 768 values
origin_and_rationale: Mean represents central visual content and standard deviation represents short-window variation without changing the frozen 384-dimensional extractor. Window5 competed against single-frame input under LOPO validation.
verification: All three deployed view-specific winners used window5; first four GUI evaluations are necessarily warm-up.
limitation: Only single-frame and five-embedding alternatives were compared; other lengths were not tested.

value: RF 300 trees and leaf 2; LR C=1 and max_iter 5000; 7-NN with distance weighting
classification: fixed candidate definitions plus experimental classifier selection
origin_and_rationale: Fixed candidate settings prevented per-view hyperparameter searches from exploiting the small cohort. Balanced RF/LR weights address unequal anchor counts; leaf 2 and seven distance-weighted neighbors reduce one-sample decisions; max_iter 5000 is a convergence ceiling.
verification: Classifier family was selected separately by LOPO video macro-F1 with sample F1 and deployment cost as tie-breakers.
limitation: The numerical hyperparameters themselves were not tuned and are not claimed optimal.

origin_and_rationale: The midpoint of P(clear) provides a prespecified binary boundary and avoids adapting the independent metric to P005.
verification: Used consistently for classifier comparison and P005 binary metrics.
limitation: predict_proba values are model scores and were not clinically calibrated probabilities.

parameter: Action-precision target and deployed abstention limits
classification: data-search followed by explicit heuristic fallback
origin_and_rationale: The OOF search sought high-coverage actions with at least 0.90 precision, but selected 0.50 for both limits. The code therefore opened a symmetric 0.30-wide uncertainty interval around 0.50 to avoid contradictory red and green boundaries.
verification: On the same OOF anchor videos, all red/green actions were correct: transverse clear 3/3 and blurry 2/3 acted; oblique 4/4 and 3/3; hepatorenal 1/3 and 2/4. Remaining anchors were yellow.
limitation: Fallback limits and 0.90 target were not independently optimized or clinically calibrated; OOF verification uses the development cohort.

value: five-decision deque; most-recent tie-break; three consecutive capture decisions
origin_and_rationale: The short majority suppresses isolated state changes, the recent-state tie-break makes the rule deterministic, and a three-decision streak prevents one or two positive spikes from producing green feedback.
verification: Shared offline and GUI classes were tested and record raw, stable and confirmed states separately.
limitation: No temporal-length or confirmation-count ablation was performed; added latency depends on source FPS and stride.

origin_and_rationale: Reduces near-duplicate saved images after a confirmed capture. It does not change raw classification, stabilization or binary metrics.
verification: The saved-capture flag and evaluated-frame index are stored in session CSV files.
limitation: No diversity optimization was performed and elapsed time varies with stride and video FPS.

value: green confirmed; yellow uncertainty/fine adjustment; red insufficient evidence
origin_and_rationale: Yellow separates an incomplete LA-dependent longitudinal decision or intermediate DINO score from a definitive rejection, allowing the user to preserve the anatomical window and adjust the probe. Green requires confirmation; red is reserved for insufficient view evidence.
verification: The GUI screenshot and session records show all mappings; technical raw states remain stored.
limitation: The colors are operational guidance, not three expert clinical labels, and no user study evaluated their usability.
